_comment: Thresholds for strategy1.py. Edit here, not in Python. Every number below is a judgement call, not a fact — if a day's read changes when you nudge one, the read was about the threshold.
_doji_body_pct: Body <= this fraction of candle range = Doji / Spinning Top. 0.28 matches mentor & student homework charts where 5-pt body on 19-pt range candle at extreme was exited as Doji.
_cost_to_cost_pts: When trade moves >= this many points in favor, stop loss moves to entry (CTC breakeven). Never let a winning trade become a loss.
_hammer_wick_ratio: Long wick must be this many times the body.
_hammer_opp_ratio: Opposite wick must be no more than this many times the body.
_engulf_ratio: Engulfing body must be this much bigger than the one it covers.
_star_penetration: Third candle of a star must close this far back through the first.
_big_candle_pts: Your number. At or above this the candle is large and a stop behind it exceeds the 40-pt budget.
_exhaust_pts: Move already run from the open. Beyond this the rally is spent — small target only.
_fixed_sl_pts: The reference stop the sizing assumes. Drives the big-candle refusal.
_gap_pts: Open vs previous close. Beyond this it is a gap and the gap rule applies: gap up blocks CE, gap down blocks PE.
_band_slope_tol: Points per candle before a Bollinger band counts as sloping rather than flat.
_band_touch_pts: Within this many points of UBB/LBB counts as reaching the band.
_flat_bb_width: BB width below this = Stage 1, rangebound.
_gap_mode_note: block | warn | off. BLOCK is correct — confirmed by Sushen in the LTA session: 'On a gap up day, don't look for calls. On a gap down day, don't look for puts.' Stated as a whole-session rule.
_range_target_note: Rangebound days target 10-15 points, not 40. Sushen: 'extreme rangebound market it will not work... in rangebound market will trade in 10 points target, optionally 15 points'.
_max_trades_note: 'One trade or two trades in a day is enough. There is no need to take 10 trades in a day.' Distinct from max_trades_range, which caps rangebound attempts specifically.
_enable_smc_runner_note: When Strategy 1 trade aligns with 15m SMC BOS/CHoCH, activate Runner Multiplier: lock stop at CTC and trail for extended 60-100+ pt liquidity pool target.

vpin._comment: VPIN parameters per Easley, Lopez de Prado & O'Hara (2010)

oi_timeline._comment: Per-Strike Intraday OI Change Timeline parameters and state thresholds
oi_timeline._interpretation_mode_note: price | oi | combined. Disagreement between combined and naive OI triggers DISAGREE state.
oi_timeline._lot_size_note: Nullable: null by default so numbers display in CONTRACTS. If set (e.g. 65), displays in lakhs as (contracts * lot_size / 100000).

greeks._comment: Black-Scholes & Put-Call Parity conventions. Spot with non-zero risk-free rate and dividend yield q.
greeks._dividend_yield_note: Configured q = +1.2% (0.012), risk_free_rate r = 6.5% (0.065). Measured futures basis (+68.0 pts over 13 DTE at spot 23,398.10) implies an effective net carry of (r - q)_implied = +8.16%, yielding an implied q = -1.66% under r = 6.5%. This creates an annualized carry gap of ~2.86% (~2.9%). As a result, the theoretical model forward is LOWER than the measured futures market forward by ~7.3 points at 4 DTE and by ~55.0 points at 30 DTE. We deliberately keep q = +1.2% because it reflects NIFTY's actual corporate dividend yield; the rich futures basis reflects margin funding/financing spreads rather than negative dividends. At 4 DTE, a +7.3 pt forward shift (using ATM gamma ~0.00133) alters call delta by approx +0.010 (+1.0 delta point, e.g. 0.602 vs 0.612 for the ~0.60 delta strike). Since 50-pt strike spacing corresponds to ~0.07-0.08 delta shift, this 0.01 delta gap represents ~1/7th of a strike and does not alter strike selection under the ~0.60 delta rule.
